settings.ekit_heading_extra_title: Dedicated to pour our hearts out

settings.ekit_team_description:
Hi!                                                                                                                                          I'm a multitasking mom of a fun-loving 6-year-old and 6-month-old boys who keep me on my toes!

As a PhD scholar, my research delves into the intersection of technology and human behavior, exploring personal and social implications of emerging technologies. I'm also a business analysis aspirant, eager to apply my skills to real-world challenges. 

When I'm not studying or playing with my sons, I love diving into movies and music, and am passionate about the ever-evolving world of marketing. 

Join me on my journey to learn and grow together!

settings.ekit_team_position: Co- Founder | COO | Vocal Artist by Passion
settings.ekit_team_description: With a background in marketing and information technology. Awais Khan possesses a deep passion for singing and cricket, exuding enthusiasm in both fields. With his exceptional vocal talents, he captivates audiences with his remarkable voice. As a vocal artist, he will contribute his musical expertise to the Random Rhythm. Alongside his creative pursuits, he also works as a marketing manager, blending his business acumen with his artistic flair. This dynamic combination allows him to excel in any project or team.
